summary.text: LaurieBeth Hager is a Democratic member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 21 since December 1, 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Hager's committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session as the House Education Committee and the House Political Subdivisions Committee.
